newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania shares ease as investors await results.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania shares ease as investors await results.

text.p: Lithuanian shares eased in dull trade on Monday and dealers said they did not expect any big gains this week.
The Litin A index slipped by 34.33 points to 2,538.48 while the official list index inched up 10.44 points to 998.99.
"We don't expect any big changes this week," said Robertas Berzinskas of Vilniaus Bank's brokerage unit.
"Investors are waiting for first quarter results and the expectations for many of the companies are not great," he said.
Investor caution was most evident in the banking sector, which turned over only 36,600 litas.
Only three banks have released their first quarter results, including Hermis Bank, which saw its share price rise to 195.00 litas from 190.00 litas in trade of 29,640 litas.
Leading bank Vilniaus Bank has not revealed its first quarter results yet and none of its shares changed hands.
Its price remained unchanged at 245.00 litas.
Dealers also said that volumes were likely to remain low because a number of key companies, such as Lithuanian Gas and Sema, were not being traded this week because of general shareholders' meetings.

Lithuanian Gas announced earlier that its shareholders' meeting, originally scheduled for Monday, had been postponed because of a disagreement with auditor Coopers & Lybrand over the methods used to calculate profit tax.
